title: gruppi/1: the same degradation in several conditions, compared on one alignment
description: Output of mzlab-feat gruppi::build (crates/mzlab-feat/src/gruppi/): per row and condition the presence, mean area of the replicates, ratio to a reference condition, shape over time and the controls as 'Prev.' suggestions; the exact sets of conditions; the decay of the parent per condition. Keys in English, fixed order, only for Tabui. A condition is a non-empty `serie` of a `sample` of campioni/2, in order of first injection; a control of `serie == ''` is shared by all. Ratios, cv and rate_rel are rounded to 6 decimals. Never a confirmation of a product and never a Schymanski level.

reference.description: the reference condition; null when none was asked or it does not exist (warning refMissing)

norm.description: raw areas; 'istd' is refused with error.gruppi.badOpts

factors.description: the optional free key/value strings of the options, kept as they came and never used in a calculation

files.description: column indices of the treated samples, in order of injection

times.description: the known treatment times in minutes, ascending

replicates.description: the largest number of replicates at one time

controls.description: column indices; for each kind the files of the condition if it has any, else the shared ones

k.description: first-order rate constant (1/min) from three or more detected times of the row marked is_parent

remaining.description: area at the last time over the mean area of the time zero of the condition

rows.description: the rows in the order received

row.description: id of the row given by the caller

other_polarity.description: id of the row of the other polarity with the same neutral mass, when the caller found one

only_in.description: the one condition, with two or more conditions in total

in_all.description: present in every condition, with two or more conditions in total

cond.description: one entry per condition, in the order of `conditions`

present.description: detected in at least ceil(min_rep_frac * n) replicates of one treated time, with a mean area of at least min_area; filled cells never count

n_det.description: replicates detected at the last time

area.description: mean area of the detected replicates at the last time (of the filled ones when none is detected, else 0)

area_sd.description: sample standard deviation; null with one replicate

ratio_ref.description: area over the area of the reference at the highest time they share; 1 for the reference, 0 for a condition where the row is not present, null without a reference, with the reference absent, or without a common time

shape.description: only where present: single with one time, null with two, else flat (max/min < 1.5), rising (maximum at the last time, or a fall of less than shape_drop after it), bell (fall of at least shape_drop), decay (maximum at the first time)

t_half_rise.description: first time, interpolated, at which the area reaches half of the maximum; only for rising and bell

rate_rel.description: t_half_rise of the reference over t_half_rise of the condition (> 1 = faster)

area.description: mean of the detected replicates; of the filled ones when none is detected, to show how absent 'absent' is

prev.description: null where the row is not present and for the row marked is_parent

absent_t0.description: the control has at most ctrl_ratio of the largest treated area

in_parent_std.description: detected in the standard of the parent with a ratio above ctrl_ratio: only a suggestion

ms2.description: na when no row of the table has a linked MS2

verdict.description: unlikely if the time zero or the blank has the ion; possible if the parent standard has it, a control is missing or the MS2 is not linked; else likely

sets.description: the exact combinations of conditions in which rows are present (never the empty one), ordered by number of rows (descending), then by the names

warnings.description: ordered by code (as listed), then by condition

condition.description: for refMissing the name asked; for mixedTimes a condition whose times differ from the reference (else from the first condition)
